c74object.name: evi_onepole_shelving
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Onepole shelving filters with simultaneous outputs
c74object.description:
evi_onepole_shelving is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_onepole_shelving.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_rcfilters.genexpr, evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_onepole_shelving is also available in MSP as: evi.onepole.shelving~.
Onepole low/high shelving filter using trapezoidal integration, simultaneous outputs, very smooth and very cheap. Frequency input in Hz, shelving input is linear -1..0..1, optional smoothing attributes are default off.

geninlet.name: frequency
geninlet.digest: in Hz @min 1 @max samplerate*0.5. The center frequency around which the filters attenuate or boost the input signal.

geninlet.name: shelf
geninlet.digest: -1..1 @min -1 @max 1 @default 0. The amount of shelving. A special normalised control: 0 = the filters are bypassed. -1..0 the filters are attenuating shelves. 0..1 the filters are boosting shelves. -1..1 equates to about ± -10..10 dB.

attribute.name: smoothfreq
attribute.description: The time in ms with which to smooth the frequency inlet control. If 0, smoothing is CPU-off.

attribute.name: smoothshelf
attribute.description: The time in ms with which to smooth the shelving inlet control. If 0, smoothing is CPU-off.
